name: Game Creator Learn
description: Free, browser-based AI tool that generates complete playable educational HTML5 games from user-configured learning parameters.

authentication.note: No authentication required. Users configure their own LLM API keys client-side (BYOK).

api_endpoints.note: No server-side API endpoints. All LLM calls happen client-side via fetch() to user-configured providers.

skills.name: educational-game-generation
skills.description: Generate complete playable educational HTML5 games from configurable learning parameters

skills.name: prompt-orchestration
skills.description: Assemble detailed structured prompts for LLMs from modular configuration

skills.name: game-refinement
skills.description: Iteratively refine generated games via multi-turn LLM conversation

security.api_key_handling: User API keys stored in localStorage, never transmitted to any server other than the configured LLM provider
